_notes.merge: For a main case, recursively merge defaults with cases[case_name]. Arrays replace whole arrays. A null override removes an inherited setting or group, leaving it unspecified as in the original namelist; it is not a Fortran value.
_notes.defaults: Defaults use repeated modal values across the 49 main *_model.in files. Settings usually omitted within a group stay case-specific. A default group is included only when it reduces overrides after accounting for absent groups. Ties use alphabetical case order, except equally common radiation schemes prefer simplified.
_notes.identity: runtype, fname_prefix, restart_path_case, datafile, forcings_file_path and stats_output_filename stay explicit per case when present. Original paths, units, timing, physics choices and omitted settings are preserved.
_notes.names: Case keys correspond to NAME_model.in. Namelist and setting names are lowercase because Fortran names are case-insensitive; derived-type components are nested objects.
_notes.legacy_variants: The eight *_model.HR.in and *_model.LR.in files retain an older namelist format with embedded profiles. legacy_variants[case][resolution] stores each complete original definition; defaults do not apply to these entries and their obsolete keys are not modernized.
_notes.array_indices: _start_index records explicit Fortran starting indices for indexed arrays in the legacy scalar soundings. Multidimensional lists have the first Fortran dimension varying fastest, as in the source namelists.
